links.comparator_used: Prompt A, which asked for PEMs 'easily understandable by the average American' with no grade level or readability formula
links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated childhood glaucoma PEMs (SMOG, FKGL)
links.effect: Prompt B (6th-grade level using SMOG) responses were more readable than Prompt A responses for all 3 LLMs (P ≤ .001)
links.quote: Prompt B responses were more readable than Prompt A responses for all 3 LLM (P ≤ .001).

links.comparator_used: Original online childhood glaucoma resources (20 from a Google search) before LLM rewriting
links.outcome: Readability of existing online materials after rewriting to a 6th-grade level (SMOG, FKGL)
links.effect: All LLMs consistently reduced mean SMOG and FKGL scores; ChatGPT-4 reached the 6th-grade level (SMOG 4.8 ± 0.8, FKGL 3.7 ± 1.9)
links.tradeoff: Only ChatGPT-4 achieved the specified 6th-grade level; ChatGPT-3.5 and Bard did not.
links.quote: Although Prompt C responses showed consistent reduction of mean SMOG and FKGL scores, only ChatGPT-4 achieved the specified 6th-grade reading level (4.8 ± 0.8 and 3.7 ± 1.9, respectively).
